name: Devnarayan Post Matric Scholarship Scheme
benefit: - Reimbursement of maintenance allowance and fee according to the time of course.
_eligibility_text:
1. The students should be a native of Rajasthan state.
1. Applicant students should belong to the following Other Backward Classes, that must have been issued by Tehsildar or a higher-level revenue officer.

   1. Banjara, Baladiya, Labana. 
   1. Gadia-Lohar, Gadolia.
   1. Gujar, Gurjar. 
   1. Raika, Raibari (Debasi).
   1. Gadariya (Gadri), Gayari.

1.  The annual income of the parents/guardian of the applicant from all sources (including the candidate's own income, if any) should be up to Rs.2,50,000 (Rupees two lakh fifty thousand in words). 
1. An employed student who studies as a full-time student by taking leave without pay during the entire course will be eligible for the scholarship.
1. All the children of the same parent/guardian will be eligible to benefit from this scheme.
